服.mn: The 月 on the left is the flesh-and-body radical; on the right a kneeling person 卩 has a hand 又 laid over them, pulling the garment on. Clothing goes onto a body, and the one who kneels obeys.

w.s: 新しい服を買いました。
w.t: I bought new clothes.

w.s: 洋服をたんすにしまう。
w.t: I put my clothes away in the dresser.

w.s: 娘は制服で学校へ行く。
w.t: My daughter goes to school in her uniform.

w.s: 面接の服装に気をつける。
w.t: I am careful about what I wear to the interview.

w.s: 祖母は和服が似合う。
w.t: Japanese clothes suit my grandmother.

寺.mn: Ground 土 on top and the measuring hand 寸 below: land carefully measured off and set aside. The plot that was marked out became the temple.

w.s: 山の上に古い寺がある。
w.t: There is an old temple on the mountain.

w.s: 正月にお寺へ行きます。
w.t: We go to the temple at New Year.

w.s: 京都には寺院が多い。
w.t: There are many temples in Kyoto.

w.s: 町の寺社を見て回った。
w.t: I went around looking at the town's temples and shrines.

w.s: 昔は寺子屋で字を習った。
w.t: Long ago people learned writing at temple schools.

息.mn: 自 was originally a drawing of a nose, and it sits right on top of the heart 心. Air from the nose down to the heart is breath.

w.s: 大きく息をすってください。
w.t: Please take a deep breath.

w.s: 息子は今年で十歳です。
w.t: My son turns ten this year.

w.s: 父はため息をついた。
w.t: My father let out a sigh.

w.s: 少し休息を取りましょう。
w.t: Let's take a short rest.

w.s: 銀行の利息は低いです。
w.t: Bank interest rates are low.

遠.mn: The road radical ⻌ runs under 袁, a long robe: 衣 with 土 and a collar 口 packed inside it. You put on the long robe before setting out down a long road.

w.s: 駅は家から遠いです。
w.t: The station is far from my house.

w.s: 遠くに富士山が見える。
w.t: I can see Mt. Fuji in the distance.

w.s: 明日は学校の遠足です。
w.t: Tomorrow is the school field trip.

w.s: 永遠に忘れません。
w.t: I will never forget it.

w.s: 遠慮なくお使いください。
w.t: Please use it freely.

絵.mn: Thread 糸 on the left and 会, to meet, on the right. Colored threads meeting on one piece of cloth make a picture.

w.s: 子どもが絵をかいています。
w.t: The child is drawing a picture.

w.s: 寝る前に絵本を読む。
w.t: I read a picture book before bed.

w.s: 美術館で絵画を見た。
w.t: I saw paintings at the museum.

w.s: 母は油絵を習っている。
w.t: My mother is learning oil painting.

w.s: 旅先から絵はがきを送る。
w.t: I send a picture postcard from my trip.

夕.mn: The moon 月 with one stroke rubbed out — the moon only half showing, faint in the sky just as the light goes. That is evening.

w.s: 夕方に犬と散歩する。
w.t: I walk the dog in the early evening.

w.s: 七時に夕食を食べます。
w.t: We eat dinner at seven.

w.s: 海に夕日がしずむ。
w.t: The setting sun sinks into the sea.

w.s: 今夜の夕飯はカレーだ。
w.t: Tonight's supper is curry.

w.s: 七夕に短冊を書いた。
w.t: I wrote a wish for the Star Festival.

板.mn: Wood 木 beside 反, to turn over: a cliff 厂 with a hand 又 flipping something. Turn a log over flat and you have a plank.

w.s: 板を切って棚を作る。
w.t: I cut a board to make a shelf.

w.s: 先生が黒板に字を書く。
w.t: The teacher writes on the blackboard.

w.s: 店の看板が新しくなった。
w.t: The shop's sign has been replaced.

w.s: 掲示板でお知らせを読む。
w.t: I read the notice on the bulletin board.

w.s: まな板を洗ってください。
w.t: Please wash the cutting board.

列.mn: On the left 歹, bare bones — a stroke 一 over 夕 — and on the right the knife 刂. Bones cut apart and laid out side by side in a neat row.

w.s: こちらの列に並んでください。
w.t: Please line up in this row.

w.s: 列車が五分おくれている。
w.t: The train is five minutes late.

w.s: 店の前に行列ができた。
w.t: A queue formed in front of the shop.

w.s: 子どもたちが整列した。
w.t: The children lined up.

w.s: 日本列島は南北に長い。
w.t: The Japanese archipelago is long from north to south.

曜.mn: The sun 日 on the left, and on the right wings 羽 over a short-tailed bird 隹. The sun takes wing and flies past, one day after another, around the week.

w.s: 今日は何曜日ですか。
w.t: What day of the week is it today?

w.s: 日曜日は市役所が休みだ。
w.t: City hall is closed on Sunday.

w.s: 月曜日から仕事が始まる。
w.t: Work starts on Monday.

w.s: 土曜日に家族と出かける。
w.t: I go out with my family on Saturday.

w.s: 金曜日の夜は飲みに行く。
w.t: I go out for drinks on Friday night.

遊.mn: On the road ⻌ goes 斿: a banner 方 with its streamer 𠂉 and a child 子 underneath. A child following the flag out of the house is going off to play.

w.s: 公園で子どもが遊ぶ。
w.t: The children play in the park.

w.s: 今日は遊びに来ました。
w.t: I came over just for fun today.

w.s: 日曜に遊園地へ行った。
w.t: We went to the amusement park on Sunday.

w.s: 公園の遊具が新しい。
w.t: The playground equipment in the park is new.

w.s: 川沿いの遊歩道を歩く。
w.t: I walk the promenade along the river.

君.mn: On top 尹, a hand ⺕ gripping a staff of office, and under it a mouth 口 giving the order. The one who holds the staff and speaks is the ruler; the word softened into a familiar way of saying you.

w.s: 君の考えを聞かせて。
w.t: Let me hear what you think.

w.s: 君たちも一緒に来ないか。
w.t: Won't you all come along too?

w.s: 諸君の協力に感謝する。
w.t: I thank you all for your cooperation.

w.s: あの国には君主がいる。
w.t: That country has a monarch.

w.s: 彼は名君と呼ばれた。
w.t: He was called a wise ruler.

雨.mn: The flat line on top is the sky, the box under it is the cloud, and the four dots inside are the drops coming down. Draw the sky, hang the cloud, then let the drops fall.

w.s: 朝から雨が降っている。
w.t: It has been raining since morning.

w.s: 大雨で電車が止まった。
w.t: The trains stopped because of the heavy rain.

w.s: 六月は梅雨に入ります。
w.t: The rainy season begins in June.

w.s: 雨天のため中止します。
w.t: It is canceled due to rain.

w.s: 雨具を持って出かける。
w.t: I take rain gear when I go out.

弱.mn: Two bows 弓 side by side, each with two little marks 冫 like feathers or cracks. A bow that has gone slack and decorative is no longer strong.

w.s: 私は寒さに弱いです。
w.t: I do not handle the cold well.

w.s: 暑さで体が弱ります。
w.t: The heat wears my body down.

w.s: 弱気にならないで。
w.t: Don't lose your nerve.

w.s: 自分の弱点を知る。
w.t: I know my own weak points.

w.s: 音の強弱をつけて読む。
w.t: I read it with strong and soft stress.

草.mn: The grass crown 艹 planted on top of 早, early — the sun 日 already over the ten 十. Grass is the thing that is up early everywhere.

w.s: 庭の草をぬきました。
w.t: I pulled the weeds in the garden.

w.s: 道ばたに草花がさく。
w.t: Flowering plants bloom by the roadside.

w.s: 雑草がすぐに生える。
w.t: Weeds grow back right away.

w.s: 春は草木が育つ。
w.t: Plants and trees grow in spring.

w.s: 広い草原が続いている。
w.t: A wide grassland stretches on.

飲.mn: Food 飠 on the left and 欠 on the right, a person with the mouth thrown wide open. Bring the food-jar to a gaping mouth and you are drinking.

w.s: 毎朝コーヒーを飲みます。
w.t: I drink coffee every morning.

w.s: 飲み物は何にしますか。
w.t: What would you like to drink?

w.s: 金曜に会社の飲み会がある。
w.t: There is a work drinking party on Friday.

w.s: 車内での飲食はご遠慮ください。
w.t: Please refrain from eating or drinking on board.

w.s: 飲料水を備えておく。
w.t: We keep drinking water in stock.

肉.mn: A cut of meat drawn from the side: the outer frame is the slab and the two bent strokes inside are the grain and sinew running through it.

w.s: 今日は肉を焼きます。
w.t: We are grilling meat today.

w.s: 牛肉は少し高いです。
w.t: Beef is a little expensive.

w.s: 豚肉と野菜をいためる。
w.t: I stir-fry pork and vegetables.

w.s: 鶏肉のスープを作った。
w.t: I made chicken soup.

w.s: 同僚と焼肉を食べに行く。
w.t: I go out for grilled meat with colleagues.

章.mn: 音, sound, with a stroke 十 ruled underneath it: the place where a piece of music or writing is cut into parts. A chapter, and by extension the badge that marks a rank.

w.s: わかりやすい文章を書く。
w.t: I write clear prose.

w.s: この本の第一章を読んだ。
w.t: I read the first chapter of this book.

w.s: 国連憲章について学ぶ。
w.t: I am learning about the UN Charter.

w.s: 祖父は勲章をもらった。
w.t: My grandfather received a medal.

w.s: 第二楽章が好きです。
w.t: I like the second movement.

酒.mn: Water 氵 beside 酉, a picture of a narrow-necked jar with a lid and a line of liquid inside. Water kept in a fermenting jar is sake.

w.s: 今夜はお酒を飲みません。
w.t: I am not drinking tonight.

w.s: 父は日本酒が好きです。
w.t: My father likes sake.

w.s: 駅前の居酒屋に集まる。
w.t: We meet at the pub by the station.

w.s: 酒屋でビールを買った。
w.t: I bought beer at the liquor store.

w.s: 飲酒運転は禁止です。
w.t: Drunk driving is prohibited.

悲.mn: 非, two wings turning away from each other and meaning not, sits on top of the heart 心. A heart saying no to what has happened is a grieving heart.

w.s: その話を聞いて悲しい。
w.t: I am sad to hear that.

w.s: 家族の死を悲しむ。
w.t: They grieve the death in the family.

w.s: 外で悲鳴が聞こえた。
w.t: I heard a scream outside.

w.s: あの事故は悲劇だった。
w.t: That accident was a tragedy.

w.s: 結果を悲観しないで。
w.t: Don't be pessimistic about the result.

秒.mn: A grain plant 禾 next to 少, a small amount. The finest tip of an ear of grain stands for the smallest slice you can measure: one second.

w.s: あと十秒待ってください。
w.t: Please wait ten more seconds.

w.s: 数秒で電気がついた。
w.t: The light came on in a few seconds.

w.s: 毎秒の速さを計る。
w.t: We measure the speed per second.

w.s: 時計の秒針が止まった。
w.t: The second hand of the clock stopped.

w.s: 風は秒速五メートルだ。
w.t: The wind is five meters per second.

晴.mn: The sun 日 on the left and 青, blue — the plant sign 龶 over 月 — on the right. Sun plus blue sky is exactly what it means for the weather to clear.

w.s: 午後には晴れるでしょう。
w.t: It should clear up in the afternoon.

w.s: 明日の天気は晴れです。
w.t: Tomorrow's weather is fine.

w.s: 晴天の日に洗濯する。
w.t: I do laundry on a fine day.

w.s: 今日は快晴で気持ちいい。
w.t: It is beautifully clear today.

w.s: 雨の晴れ間に外へ出た。
w.t: I went out during a break in the rain.

暗.mn: The sun 日 next to 音, sound. When the sun is shut out and you have only sounds to go by, it is dark.

w.s: 部屋が暗いので電気をつける。
w.t: The room is dark, so I turn on the light.

w.s: 漢字を暗記しています。
w.t: I am memorizing kanji.

w.s: 暗証番号を入力してください。
w.t: Please enter your PIN.

w.s: 外はもう真っ暗だ。
w.t: It is already pitch dark outside.

w.s: 暗号でメールを送る。
w.t: I send the mail encrypted.

鳥.mn: A whole bird seen from the side: the short slash on top is the head, the line under it the eye, the body strokes are the folded wing, and the four dots 灬 at the bottom are the tail feathers.

w.s: 庭に鳥が来ています。
w.t: There are birds in the garden.

w.s: 小鳥の声で目が覚めた。
w.t: I woke to the sound of small birds.

w.s: 焼き鳥を二本ください。
w.t: Two chicken skewers, please.

w.s: 湖に白鳥がいました。
w.t: There were swans on the lake.

w.s: 川で野鳥を観察する。
w.t: I watch wild birds at the river.

勉.mn: 免, to be excused or get away, with strength 力 added under it. Throw your strength at the task so you can finally be let off: that is studying hard.

w.s: 毎晩日本語を勉強します。
w.t: I study Japanese every evening.

w.s: 会社の勉強会に出る。
w.t: I attend the study group at work.

w.s: 彼は勤勉な社員です。
w.t: He is a diligent employee.

w.s: 勉学に打ち込む。
w.t: I devote myself to my studies.

w.s: 不勉強でお恥ずかしい。
w.t: I am embarrassed at how little I have studied.

陽.mn: The hill 阝 on the left, and on the right 昜: the sun 日 above the horizon line 一 with rays 勿 streaming down from it. The sunlit side of the hill.

w.s: 太陽が高くのぼった。
w.t: The sun has risen high.

w.s: 彼女は陽気な人です。
w.t: She is a cheerful person.

w.s: 夕陽が山にしずむ。
w.t: The setting sun goes down behind the mountain.

w.s: 春の陽光が暖かい。
w.t: The spring sunlight is warm.

w.s: 検査の結果は陽性でした。
w.t: The test result was positive.

冬.mn: On top 夂, a pair of trailing feet marking the end of the year, and under it the two ice marks 冫. The year drags to a close and everything freezes.

w.s: 北海道の冬は寒いです。
w.t: Winters in Hokkaido are cold.

w.s: 冬休みは実家に帰る。
w.t: I go back to my parents' place for the winter break.

w.s: 真冬でも自転車に乗る。
w.t: I ride my bike even in midwinter.

w.s: そろそろ冬服を出す。
w.t: It is about time to get out the winter clothes.

w.s: 冬季の電気代は高い。
w.t: Electricity bills are high in winter.

皮.mn: A hand at the lower right is pulling downward on the covering above it. Someone stripping the hide off an animal in one motion.

w.s: りんごの皮をむきます。
w.t: I peel the apple.

w.s: 冬は皮膚がかわく。
w.t: My skin gets dry in winter.

w.s: 毛皮のコートは重い。
w.t: A fur coat is heavy.

w.s: 皮肉を言わないで。
w.t: Don't be sarcastic.

w.s: 皮革の製品を売る店だ。
w.t: It is a shop that sells leather goods.

里.mn: A field 田 resting on the earth 土. Where the fields are worked, people settle down — the village, and the home place you go back to.

w.s: 母の里は九州です。
w.t: My mother's home town is in Kyushu.

w.s: 正月に里帰りします。
w.t: I visit my parents at New Year.

w.s: 里親の制度を調べた。
w.t: I looked into the foster parent system.

w.s: 郷里の友人に会った。
w.t: I met a friend from my home town.

w.s: 静かな山里に住む。
w.t: They live in a quiet mountain village.

歯.mn: 止 sits on top just to lend the sound; underneath, the open mouth 凵 holds rows of teeth drawn as 米. Draw the mouth, then fill it with teeth.

w.s: 歯がとても痛いです。
w.t: My tooth hurts a lot.

w.s: 午後に歯医者へ行きます。
w.t: I am going to the dentist this afternoon.

w.s: 虫歯を治してもらった。
w.t: I had my cavity treated.

w.s: 駅前の歯科に予約した。
w.t: I made an appointment at the dental clinic by the station.

w.s: 朝晩の歯磨きを忘れない。
w.t: I never skip brushing my teeth morning and night.

昼.mn: 尺, a hand measuring a span, laid over 旦 — the sun 日 sitting on the horizon 一. Measuring off the stretch of the day the sun is up gives you midday.

w.s: 昼になったら出かけます。
w.t: I will go out around noon.

w.s: 昼休みに銀行へ行く。
w.t: I go to the bank during my lunch break.

w.s: 社員食堂で昼食をとる。
w.t: I have lunch in the company cafeteria.

w.s: 昼間は家にいません。
w.t: I am not home during the day.

w.s: 昼ご飯はおにぎりです。
w.t: Lunch is rice balls.

茶.mn: The grass crown 艹 over a person 人 standing under a tree 木. Leaves picked from the bush and carried home to be brewed: tea.

w.s: お茶を入れましょうか。
w.t: Shall I make some tea?

w.s: 茶色のかばんを買った。
w.t: I bought a brown bag.

w.s: 朝は紅茶を飲みます。
w.t: I drink black tea in the morning.

w.s: 駅前の喫茶店で待つ。
w.t: I will wait at the coffee shop by the station.

w.s: 妻は茶道を習っている。
w.t: My wife is learning the tea ceremony.

柱.mn: Wood 木 beside 主, master — a lamp flame 丶 above the stand 王. The piece of timber that is master of the house is the pillar holding it up.

w.s: 柱に時計をかけました。
w.t: I hung a clock on the pillar.

w.s: 家の前に電柱がある。
w.t: There is a utility pole in front of the house.

w.s: 父は家の大黒柱だ。
w.t: My father is the breadwinner of the family.

w.s: 木に支柱を立てた。
w.t: We put a support post by the tree.

w.s: 円柱の形をした建物だ。
w.t: It is a cylinder-shaped building.

祭.mn: A piece of meat 月 and a hand held above the altar 示. Meat set on the altar by hand is an offering, and the offering is the festival.

w.s: 町の祭りに参加した。
w.t: I took part in the town festival.

w.s: 神社に神を祭る。
w.t: A deity is enshrined at the shrine.

w.s: 夏祭りで花火を見た。
w.t: I watched fireworks at the summer festival.

w.s: 祭日は役所が閉まる。
w.t: Government offices close on national holidays.

w.s: 来週は学校の文化祭だ。
w.t: The school festival is next week.

雪.mn: Rain 雨 on top and the hand-with-a-broom ⺕ underneath. Snow is the rain you have to sweep off the path.

w.s: 朝から雪が降っている。
w.t: It has been snowing since morning.

w.s: 大雪で道が通れない。
w.t: The road is impassable from the heavy snow.

w.s: 今年の初雪が降った。
w.t: This year's first snow fell.

w.s: 朝早く除雪をします。
w.t: We clear the snow early in the morning.

w.s: 子どもと雪だるまを作る。
w.t: I make a snowman with my child.

筆.mn: Bamboo 竹 on top and 聿 below: a hand ⺕ gripping an upright shaft 丨. A hand holding a bamboo shaft is a writing brush.

w.s: 筆で名前を書きます。
w.t: I write my name with a brush.

w.s: 鉛筆で下書きをする。
w.t: I make a rough draft in pencil.

w.s: 筆記試験は来週です。
w.t: The written test is next week.

w.s: 万年筆で手紙を書く。
w.t: I write letters with a fountain pen.

w.s: 筆者の考えに賛成だ。
w.t: I agree with the author's view.

童.mn: 立, a person standing, set on top of 里, the village. The small ones standing about in the village are the children.

w.s: 児童が公園で遊ぶ。
w.t: The children play in the park.

w.s: 子どもに童話を読む。
w.t: I read fairy tales to my child.

w.s: 童謡を一緒に歌った。
w.t: We sang a children's song together.

w.s: 学童の見守りをする。
w.t: I help watch over the schoolchildren.

w.s: 童心にかえって遊ぶ。
w.t: I play like a child again.

弟.mn: A cord wound in order around a stake, the loops shown by 弓 and 丨 and the little tail 丿 at the end. Things wound in order gave the sense of the one who comes next: the younger brother.

w.s: 弟は大阪で働いています。
w.t: My younger brother works in Osaka.

w.s: 兄弟は何人いますか。
w.t: How many siblings do you have?

w.s: 職人に弟子入りした。
w.t: He became an apprentice to a craftsman.

w.s: 義弟が家に来ました。
w.t: My brother-in-law came over.

w.s: 実弟と会社を始めた。
w.t: I started a company with my own younger brother.

畑.mn: Fire 火 beside a field 田. Land cleared by burning it off grows vegetables and wheat rather than rice. This character was made in Japan.

w.s: 畑で野菜を育てます。
w.t: I grow vegetables in the field.

w.s: 祖父の田畑を継いだ。
w.t: I took over my grandfather's fields.

w.s: 山の上に花畑がある。
w.t: There is a field of flowers on the hill.

w.s: 麦畑が風にゆれる。
w.t: The wheat field sways in the wind.

w.s: この地域は畑作が多い。
w.t: Dry field farming is common in this area.

毛.mn: Three strokes of a tuft, and the last one bends and curls up at the tip. That flick at the end is what makes it hair rather than a straight line.

w.s: 猫の毛が服につく。
w.t: Cat hair gets on my clothes.

w.s: 寒いので毛布を出した。
w.t: It was cold, so I got out a blanket.

w.s: 髪の毛を短く切った。
w.t: I cut my hair short.

w.s: 眉毛を整えています。
w.t: I am trimming my eyebrows.

w.s: 羊毛のセーターは暖かい。
w.t: A wool sweater is warm.

緑.mn: Thread 糸 beside 彔: a hand ⺕ squeezing a plant so the juice 氺 runs out below. The dye pressed out of leaves colors the thread green.

w.s: 公園の緑がきれいだ。
w.t: The greenery in the park is lovely.

w.s: 緑色のかさを買った。
w.t: I bought a green umbrella.

w.s: 食後に緑茶を飲みます。
w.t: I drink green tea after meals.

w.s: 市が緑地を守っている。
w.t: The city protects the green space.

w.s: 五月の新緑が美しい。
w.t: The fresh green of May is beautiful.
